sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.inspection_scope: Downloaded and inspected the complete 40-page NIST AI 100-1 PDF. Reviewed its stated voluntary, non-sector-specific scope; MAP context/knowledge-limit/data-TEVV outcomes; MEASURE testing, uncertainty and independent-review discussion; and MANAGE change/recovery outcomes.

regions.excerpt: knowledge limits and how system output may be utilized and overseen
associated measures of uncertainty, comparisons to performance benchmarks
supersede, disengage, or deactivate AI systems

sources.limitations: This is voluntary horizontal risk-management guidance, not a transportation certification basis, acceptance criterion, probability-of-safety method or approval of a particular system. NIST states AI RMF 1.0 is under revision; recheck before publication.

sources.title: Assured Autonomy through Combinatorial Methods
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology and Virginia Tech National Security Institute
sources.inspection_scope: Downloaded and inspected the complete five-page paper. Reviewed its contrast between conventional structural coverage and learned-model inputs, its combinatorial data-coverage method, transfer-learning example and stated boundaries.

regions.locator: PDF p. 3, structural versus input coverage discussion
regions.excerpt: it is not yet clear how closely this form of coverage is related to model performance

regions.locator: PDF p. 5, transfer-learning and conclusion discussion
regions.excerpt: identify where even large volumes of data are insufficient

sources.limitations: This is a methods paper, not a demonstrated certification process. A coverage measure depends on the selected variables, discretization and interaction strength; it does not establish a failure rate, simulator fidelity or safe system behavior by itself.

sources.title: Scalable End-to-End Autonomous Vehicle Testing via Rare-event Simulation
sources.publisher: O'Kelly, Sinha, Namkoong, Duchi and Tedrake
sources.inspection_scope: Downloaded and inspected the complete 18-page arXiv version. Reviewed the abstract, base-distribution definition, simulator inputs, importance-sampling process and authors' stated scope for a multi-agent highway scenario.

regions.excerpt: probability of an accident under a base distribution governing standard traffic behavior

regions.locator: PDF p. 2, base distribution and simulation inputs
regions.excerpt: an essential component of this approach is to estimate the base distribution

sources.limitations: This is a research preprint, not a regulator-approved safety case. Its estimated probability is conditional on the base distribution, scenario abstraction, simulator and selected risk threshold; it does not validate those assumptions or transfer the result to aircraft encounters.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
sources.jurisdiction: Machine-learning research; image and document classification experiments
sources.inspection_scope: Downloaded and inspected the complete six-page arXiv version. Reviewed its calibration definition, experiments showing poor calibration in studied modern networks, and temperature-scaling evaluation.

regions.excerpt: modern neural networks, unlike those from a decade ago, are poorly calibrated

regions.locator: PDF pp. 2-3, calibration and temperature-scaling experiments
regions.excerpt: a single-parameter variant of Platt Scaling

sources.limitations: The experiments cover selected classification datasets and architectures. Calibration on a held-out distribution does not show calibrated uncertainty under operational distribution shift, correlated sensor faults or closed-loop control effects.

sources.title: A Verification Framework for Runtime Assurance of Autonomous UAS
sources.jurisdiction: US research; autonomous uncrewed aircraft systems
sources.inspection_scope: Downloaded and inspected the complete 14-page DASC presentation. Reviewed the Simplex architecture, Plaidypvs rule, explicit safe-state/recovery/reversionary-controller premises, and productive-conflict-avoidance assumptions.

regions.locator: PDF pp. 5-8, Simplex architecture and Plaidypvs rule
regions.excerpt: formally verify UAS operations where the vehicle is guided by a black box controller

regions.locator: PDF pp. 8-12, RTA premises and productive-conflict-avoidance example
regions.excerpt: the monitored advanced system controller always ends in a state where the vehicle can recover

sources.limitations: A formalized research framework and presentation are not a civil approval, an implementation audit, or evidence that perception failures can always be observed early enough. The guarantee is conditional on model, monitor, timing, dynamics, switching and recovery-controller premises. This is the same NASA/Plaidypvs runtime-assurance method family as S-010 and S-METHOD2-003; it supplies separately inspected presentation context and is not independent corroboration.

sources.title: Sanity Checks for Saliency Maps
sources.publisher: Adebayo, Gilmer, Muelly, Goodfellow, Hardt and Kim
sources.jurisdiction: Machine-learning interpretability research; visual classification experiments
sources.inspection_scope: Downloaded and inspected the complete 20-page arXiv version, including the abstract, model/data randomization tests and stated findings for the saliency methods evaluated.

regions.excerpt: reliance, solely, on visual assessment can be misleading
some of the methods tested are independent of both the model parameters and the labeling

sources.limitations: The paper evaluates selected saliency methods and model/data settings. It does not establish that every interpretability technique fails, nor provide a safety acceptance criterion; its randomization checks must be adapted and validated for the explanation's intended assurance role.

sources.title: From Neuron Coverage to Steering Angle: Testing Autonomous Vehicles Effectively
sources.publisher: Toohey, Raunak and Binkley; National Institute of Standards and Technology publication record
sources.jurisdiction: Autonomous-vehicle testing research; one studied DNN
sources.inspection_scope: Downloaded and inspected the complete eight-page paper. Reviewed its transformed-image test setup, correlation result, stated threats to validity and conclusion about neuron-coverage adequacy.

regions.locator: PDF pp. 7-8, correlation and threats to validity
regions.excerpt: we do not know that the increase in neuron coverage is causing the increase
there is a need for further investigation to discover whether neuron coverage is a consistent indicator

sources.limitations: The experiment involved one DNN and steering-angle-deviation proxy, with no established failure threshold. It cannot validate a neuron-coverage score as safety evidence for a perception/planning stack or an aviation DAA system.
